findings.claim: UntrustedData's MaximumObjectGraphDepth is raised from 500 to 5000, a tenfold increase unrelated to the generator crash fix. Deserializing untrusted data with deep nesting that previously threw InsufficientExecutionStackException or hit the depth limit is now accepted, and the stack-overflow protection is weakened. This is a behavior change and security regression that the requirement did not ask for, and it contradicts the ledger's stack depth limit of 500 (L9).

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a payload nested 1000 levels deep (e.g. nested single-element arrays) with MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData using base-built and head-built code. Base throws MessagePackSerializationException (depth exceeded); head succeeds, or risks a stack overflow at deeper nesting.

findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wraps every analyzer diagnostic and silently drops any whose location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation. Diagnostics previously reported with Location.None (or null locations) would no longer appear in users' builds, e.g. MemberNeedsKey on an inherited member from a referenced base type, as ledger L13 considers. This is broader than the crash fix, so some MsgPack00x diagnostics (MsgPack003/004/005) would stop being reported.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a [MessagePackObject] class in the compiling assembly derives from a base class in a referenced assembly with a public member lacking [Key]. Compare MsgPack004 reporting at base vs head. Also test diagnostics that use Location.None or a null location.
